briefdescription.para: Polynomial-ring view tuned for the inner loop of classical Buchberger Groebner-basis computations.

detaileddescription.para: Holds the coefficient ring, the (flattened) monoid, and the Schreyer-order machinery, and exposes the gbvector arithmetic primitives (gbvector_add_to, gbvector_mult_by_term, ...) that the GB inner loop calls millions of times. Subclasses (GBRingPoly, GBRingSkew, GBRingWeyl, GBRingWeylZZ, GBRingSolvable) override mult_by_term1 to encode ring-specific commutation rules. Built once per computation from a PolynomialRing and torn down at the end.
